name: improve
description: Read-only codebase advisory skill/plugin producing prioritized audit findings and self-contained implementation plans for other agents, including plan review and execution-handoff guidance.

metadata.github_description: Use your most capable model to audit your codebase and write plans for cheaper models to execute.
